svg.text: K2b VESSEL STACK INVERSION — the Wender: one gripper, never above food
A rear-lane carriage (X, Z, roll, jaw) grips vessel rims and tool necks on one ware line; a turning hob does the force work.
1350 × 600 × 2000 mm · deck at z 900 · oven outside
6 actuators (X, Z, roll, jaw, T, S) · 4 dynamic seals
est. cost ≈ 9.1 k€ machine + bought hob ≈ 0.56 k€
TOP VIEW at the deck (z 900), rear wall at the top
REAR LANE: mast, Z, roll unit travel here (X 120–1220)

g.text: knead: roller on the rim, arm in the anchor fork

svg.text: X belt carriage in a dry box at the top of the rear lane
Z ball screw on a hanging mast; jaw centre z 920–1940
roll about y: tips, pours about the lip, flips pairs
jaw one V-groove pair grips rims (Ø 290) and tool necks (T45)
weighs every grip on two finger load pins (±5 g)
Nothing of the Wender is ever above an open vessel
T turns, the Wender holds: force from the turning hob KH
Pour about the lip; flip pairs at z ≤ 1200 over the hob
All heat on one deck; everything food-touching is loose ware
Washed in the wash lift W during and after the meal

g.text: 1/7 Box in: the transport sets an opened box of mince on the landing; the jaws take its flanges and the roll tips it into the pot on KH (weighed)
2/7 Kneading: the roller hangs on the pot rim, its arm in the anchor fork; T turns the pot. The Wender is free and fetches the disher from the carousel
3/7 Portioning: the disher takes balls from the pot on KH and drops them into the pan on H2; the jaws move only along the ware line
4/7 Turning: each patty is lifted by the turner and turned by 180° of roll, one by one
5/7 The empty pot goes to the wash lift; a plate carrier comes from the landing onto KH
6/7 Plating by polar placement: T turns the plate so each spot comes to the ware line; patties are set down; the carrier leaves via the landing
7/7 Washing: the jaws raise the rack by its handle (a cam opens the lid), set the pan upside down on it and lower it; 85 °C rinse
